messages:
incidentbot: PAGED (auto): prometheus:exporter_scrape_errors firing on 3 clusters — paging oncall

incidentbot: Rule: prometheus_exporter_errors > 10 for 2m — see https://alerts/redwood/prometheus_exporter_errors

nora: acked — looking

kevin: saw a flurry of identical alerts from the redis-exporter group, looks like a config churn earlier. restarting collector may help

alix: agree. I can mute duplicate alerts for 10m with alertmanager silence, want me to? :mute:

nora: yes please silence duplicates, but keep severe ones (scrape failures) live. can you add a note to the silence about exporter restart?

alix: adding silence now: 
```
amtool silence add --service prometheus --matchers 'job=redis-exporter' --duration 10m --comment 'temporary mute while we restart exporters to stop duplicate errors'
```

alix: done — silence id 0a1b2c — will expire in 10m :white_check_mark:

mike: quick check: kafka lag for log-ingest for those clusters? if exporters are spamming, ingest backlog could grow

kevin: kafka consumer lag is normal, no backlog. logs show exporter TLS handshake errors then stream of 429s from scrape proxy:
```
[2026-03-15T15:03:10Z] redis-exporter-1 tls: handshake error: remote error: bad certificate
[2026-03-15T15:03:12Z] scrape-proxy 429 Too Many Requests for /metrics from redis-exporter-1
[2026-03-15T15:03:12Z] redis-exporter-1 exporter_scrape_error=1
```

nora: so config rollout introduced cert mismatch, scrape proxy throttled them, then exporter logged errors => alert fanout. plan: patch cert, restart pods, throttle on scrape-proxy reverted. I can do the cert patch in staging then prod patch if green

kevin: I can restart the exporter deployment in the affected clusters to break the immediate error spike: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/redis-exporter`

nora: do it in canary cluster first, confirm metrics return, then roll to other two

kevin: canary restart triggered

incidentbot: Alert suppressed by silence 0a1b2c, related alerts: 3 suppressed

kevin: canary shows metrics back within 30s, scrape errors dropped to 0, prometheus target UP restored

mike: confirming no customer-facing errors in SLO dashboard, external request latency unaffected. internal dashboards missing redis metrics for ~45m but no user impact flagged by product metrics

nora: good. rolling to remaining clusters now, applying same restart and cert fix. callout to runtime team to check why cert was invalid after rollout (tagging @runtime-bot)

runtime-bot: @nora acknowledged — creating ticket RT-2026 to track exporter cert rotation check and alert suppression policy update

alix: removing silence early, everything looks stable; silence id 0a1b2c removed

incidentbot: All instances of prometheus:exporter_scrape_errors resolved — alert closed

nora: short postmortem notes: root cause cert mismatch from a zero-downtime rollout that skipped secret refresh, led to transient TLS errors + scrape-proxy rate-limiting which amplified into PagerDuty flurry. Action items: 1) runtime ticket RT-2026 for secret refresh enforcement, 2) update playbook to add targeted silences instead of broad muting, 3) add a suppression rule in alertmanager for duplicate identical messages within 1m to avoid autopage storms.

kevin: i'll add the rollout quick-check to the infra deploy script (verify secret checksum post-rollout).

mike: i'll flag customers with possible partial metric gaps in Operations for transparency, but note no feature degradation. will send a short note once RT-2026 has next steps

nora: thanks all — closing the loop. I'll file the incident brief and link RT-2026 and the alert history.
